Action (adapt to scope): Start the room using its normal interface.
Expected result (agree before test): Agreed devices and routes reach the required startup state.

Action (adapt to scope): Select each agreed source for each intended display in turn.
Expected result (agree before test): Each intended display shows the selected source with the agreed image format.

Action (adapt to scope): Play approved content and select each required speaker zone.
Expected result (agree before test): The agreed source is audible in intended zones at the agreed operating level.

Action (adapt to scope): Speak normally from each agreed participant position during a test call.
Expected result (agree before test): Far-end participant confirms intelligible speech from every tested position.

Action (adapt to scope): Far-end caller speaks while local listeners check agreed seats.
Expected result (agree before test): Local listeners hear intelligible speech in the intended zones.

Action (adapt to scope): Both sides hold a natural conversation including overlapping speech.
Expected result (agree before test): Participants confirm the agreed conversational performance, recording any echo or lost words.

Action (adapt to scope): Operate each scoped mute control, then restore it.
Expected result (agree before test): Local and far-end paths mute and unmute according to the agreed room behaviour.

Action (adapt to scope): For each scoped host, select intended AV devices in the actual call application.
Expected result (agree before test): The intended camera, microphone and speaker paths work for that host and application.

Action (adapt to scope): If scoped, speak into each local microphone at the agreed operating level.
Expected result (agree before test): Speech reaches intended local zones without unacceptable feedback or distortion.

Action (adapt to scope): Operate scoped source, volume, mute and device controls.
Expected result (agree before test): Panel feedback agrees with the observed device and room state where feedback is available.

Action (adapt to scope): If scoped, test each combined or separated mode and its transitions.
Expected result (agree before test): Audio, video and controls follow the agreed mode matrix without unintended cross-room routing.

Action (adapt to scope): Perform only a specifically approved recovery scenario with recovery support present.
Expected result (agree before test): The agreed recovery path succeeds and affected user workflows pass their retest.
Required participants: Authorized local technician and remote programmer

Action (adapt to scope): End the session through the normal interface.
Expected result (agree before test): Displays, audio and routes reach the agreed shutdown state.
